rationale: C107 flagged negative cost values, but the raw investment schedule itself reports those costs as parenthesized amounts in the Cost column for the same issuers and investment types. The extracted values preserve the source sign rather than introducing a data error; the warning is therefore a rule-scope false alarm for source-reported negative costs.
